profile_text.body:
UC Berkeley / vLLM Team is a university lab associated with the vLLM project. The listed website is github.com, but the text collected from that page describes GitHub rather than vLLM. That page calls GitHub "the world's most widely adopted, AI-powered developer platform" and says it offers AI and automation tools for building and shipping software.

The held facts identify one product, vLLM, described as a high-throughput inference engine that is open-source, self-hosted, and shares no external data. The entity is recorded as a university lab and not for profit. No litigation or MCP servers are noted in the available facts.
